findings: SIZE CORRECTED: the 3.17GB DSR longplay is deleted. refs/ went 3.4GB -> 279MB (now ~333MB because a CONCURRENT AGENT is adding wiki GIFs to souls-behaviour/, see below). refs/video/ is 6.1MB against a 250MB cap; a 40MB per-file guard is asserted in commit.py.

CONCURRENT AGENT ACTIVE: 29 .gif files appeared under souls-behaviour/{arena,attacks,...} at 13:23-13:24 with NO provenance records yet (largest 10.0MB, within the 40MB guard). They are not mine. Any provenance write must LOAD-MODIFY-WRITE (scratchpad/prov.py does); make-manifest.py must be re-run after that agent finishes or MANIFEST will under-report.

VIDEO MECHANIC (the reusable one): the static ffmpeg here SEGFAULTS on https input (exit 139) and YouTube is bot-gated, so neither yt-dlp --download-sections nor ffmpeg -i <url> works. What works: build a SPARSE local file the remote length, fill [0, moov_end) (faststart index at the front) plus a window around the wanted timestamp via curl -r, then run ffmpeg -c copy against the sparse file. Two clips were cut from a 3.17GB source having stored under 150MB. scratchpad/clip.py implements it. archive.org 500s on bursts of range requests and needs patient retry.

V1-dolly / V2-static STILL UNFILLED. Newly ruled out: archive.org 'elden-ring-game-movie-720p-60-fps-bazitube' (1.8GB, 98min, 720p, HAS an .ia.mp4 derivative so it is reachable and cuttable) — 8 frames sampled at 10-minute intervals are ALL boss fights or cutscenes. It is a montage; V1 cannot use cuts. The RDR2 100% longplay is 82GB with no derivative.

A7 MET AT ALL THREE SCALES: A21 9/9 regions all >=4 (Ascadian 12, Ashlands 10, Bitter Coast 9, West Gash 7, Sheogorad 6, Azura's Coast 5, Red Mountain 5, Grazelands 4, Molag Amur 4); A22 Ascadian 9 / Bitter Coast 6; A23 all 9 regions >=1, 11 files.

A7 SETS ARE DEFINED BY A FIELD, NOT A FOLDER: 41 new files in REF-A21-regions/ plus 17 already-committed regional exteriors tagged a21_member:true + region + region_basis. Any dispersion tool must select on the field, not walk the directory, or it will miss 17 files and skew the centroids.

REGION ATTRIBUTION EVIDENCE LADDER, recorded per file in region_basis: map-inset (the frame contains Morrowind's own local-map window naming the region — strongest, needs no interpretation) > landmark (Dagon Fel's Nordic town, Sadrith Mora's Telvanni towers, the Ghostfence, Red Mountain's caldera) > gallery-tag (uploader's region name in the search, confirmed by eye). Nothing attributed on appearance alone.

A23 DEVIATION: strictly downward-facing Morrowind screenshots are near-nonexistent — nobody photographs the floor, which is §3's anti-curation bias appearing at the micro scale. Substituted near-ground frames where terrain fills the majority of the frame and no skyline carries the distinction, which is the property A7 actually needs.
A7 CLOSED REF-A3 FOR FREE: the Sadrith Mora frames acquired for Azura's Coast are full-frame Telvanni mushroom towers, which was the one slot §15.6 reported with no full-frame re-acquisition.

THE BINDING CONSTRAINT ON THE MODERN SIDE IS block_score, NOT COVERAGE: 199 files carry heavily_recompressed:true from COMPUTED block_score > 1.15 (19 of 22 in interior_darkemissive, 16 of 24 in exterior_lowlight). Steam re-encodes user screenshot uploads. More Steam downloads cannot fix these two profiles; a different KIND of source will.

PROVENANCE STRUCTURE DEFECT (root cause of H2/H3): 68 records were keyed by bare id while make-manifest.py joins BY PATH, so 140 files produced PROVENANCE_MISSING. Fixed by copying each id-keyed record down to its path key with provenance_inherited_from.

STEAM publishedfileid is monotonic in time — 97 directly-read page dates, 0 violations, Feb 2014 to Mar 2024. sid < ~2.9e9 == pre-2023 == §8b pre-2023-page. Primary triage filter, plus a bracket-inference route (95 direct + 145 bracketed + 36 unresolved).

MORROWIND VANILLA TRIAGE: ~4 in 5 top-rated Morrowind screenshots at >=1920 wide FAIL V2 (MGE XE / OpenMW distant land). Filter to <=1366 native width, then eyes. The vanilla fog wall closing the middle distance is the discriminator.

notes_for_successor: Tooling in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-elder-souls-claude/3c195166-6f14-54d0-bf0f-867f7b39d84b/scratchpad/: fetch.py (stage download), sheet.py (contact sheets — the single biggest efficiency win, triage 25 candidates per image read), commit.py (copy exact bytes + merge provenance, asserts the 40MB guard), prov.py (MERGE-ONLY _provenance writer), harvest2.py (Steam listing harvester; the id is in data-publishedfileid and the page URL in data-modal-content-url, NOT a plain href), clip.py (sparse-file remote video cutting), metaloop.py, postpass.py (§8a computed thresholds), backfill_dates.py (§8b), finalise.py, run_*.py (commit batches, each self-documenting). stage-index.json holds sha256+dims+url for ~2100 staged candidates — committing more from there costs no downloads and is the cheapest place to continue.
